summary: PERKLOCKS Final Universal Root Closure sweep — backend + frontend. 11/11 pytest cases green. Board↔Detail parity holds (Sassuolo -0.25 card 89/74.2%/+27.03%/Playable identical on Pick Breakdown; Dortmund BTTS Yes recorded 89/79.11%/+2.92%/Playable via API — matches spec). Truth manifest fields (api_origin, environment, board_version, generated_at, data_as_of) all present at /api/picks/today?lite=true and every pick carries truth_fingerprint + publication_version. /api/nfl/atd/slate returns board_version, publication_version, generated_at, data_as_of, universe_count, top5, games with 5 games / 62 candidates; top5 equals first-5 of /api/nfl/atd/leaderboard; no duplicate players within a game. Rollover returns rollover_version='v6-official-slate' with 3 stable legs across consecutive calls (Dortmund/PSG-Marseille/Werder-Dortmund Total Goals Over 2.5, LS 89). Frontend: login → Locks board renders picks (no Connection Hiccup); direct /atd route renders Top 5 Today and By Game views with atd-toggle-top / atd-toggle-game testIDs and VIEW ALL (n) buttons; Rollover tab renders 3 legs. One UX finding: the ATD screen has NO bottom-tab entry (bottom nav shows only LOCKS · ROLLOVER · PARLAY · MY BETS · LAB · PROFILE) — accessible only via deep-link /atd. React Native: only harmless deprecation warnings ('shadow*' → 'boxShadow', 'textShadow*' → 'textShadow', 'props.pointerEvents' → 'style.pointerEvents'). No blank screens, no red screens, no 500s.

ui_bugs.issue: ATD screen has no visible bottom-tab entry — reachable only via direct URL /atd. Bottom nav shows only LOCKS, ROLLOVER, PARLAY, MY BETS, LAB, PROFILE. Users cannot navigate to ATD from within the app UI.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated style props emitted at runtime: 'shadow*' → use 'boxShadow'; 'textShadow*' → use 'textShadow'; 'props.pointerEvents' → use 'style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: browser console warnings on / and /atd.

action_items: Confirm intended navigation to ATD screen — if it should be reachable from bottom tabs, add ATD to the (tabs) group; if intentionally hidden, provide an in-app entry point (deep link from Locks header or promo card).
Migrate deprecated RN-Web style props: 'shadow*'→'boxShadow', 'textShadow*'→'textShadow', 'props.pointerEvents'→'style.pointerEvents' to silence console warnings and future-proof for RN-Web upgrades.
(Optional) Surface truth_manifest.board_version in a debug/DEV-only footer so QA can eyeball parity in future test runs.
critical_code_review_comments: picks_routes.py + published_prediction_reader.py deliver identical list-vs-detail objects — parity verified with 5 picks + Dortmund BTTS Yes.
nfl_atd_slate.py correctly deduplicates candidates within each game and aligns top5 with leaderboard order.
rollover_official_slate.py returns a stable slate object with slate_id='rollover:2026-09-18:official' — leg ids stable across 2 consecutive calls.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows green; 1 minor navigation gap for ATD)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Board↔detail response shape: /api/picks/{id} returns pick fields at TOP LEVEL (not wrapped in a 'pick' key — the 'pick' field at top level is a legacy string). Use `detail if 'lock_score' in detail else detail.get('pick')`. Rollover legs live under response['picks'] (array of 3), NOT response['slate']['legs']. Frontend ScrollView on Locks board is a nested overflow:auto div, not the window — use JS: `document.querySelector('.css-view-g5y9jx.r-overflowY-1rnoaur').scrollBy(0, N)` or page.mouse.wheel(). ATD screen is only reachable via direct URL /atd (no bottom-tab entry). Dortmund BTTS Yes is on the slate but requires deep scroll of the Locks list — testing via API is faster.
rca_of_issue: No product defects found this iteration. Prior iter138 CRITICAL (NFL alt-ladder label wiring) is out-of-scope for this closure sweep and was not re-tested.
